name: San Jose
tagline: Silicon Valley's Capital with Perfect Weather and Sky-High Costs
description: San Jose sits at the heart of Silicon Valley, offering Mediterranean weather, incredible ethnic food diversity, and proximity to the Pacific coast and Sierra Nevada mountains. However, its astronomical housing costs and California's high state income tax make it one of the most challenging FIRE destinations in America. You need a significantly larger portfolio here than almost anywhere else, but in return you get year-round sunshine, world-class tech infrastructure, and a culturally rich community shaped by immigration from around the globe.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate to Good – safer than most large US cities
quickFacts.climate: Mediterranean with warm dry summers and mild wet winters

housing.description: A modest studio in a working East San Jose or Berryessa neighborhood, where the Bay Area rent floor keeps it the largest line

dining.description: Home cooking plus San Jose's superb, affordable Vietnamese, Mexican, and pan-Asian food

healthcare.description: A subsidized Covered California plan for Santa Clara County, assuming annual income stays under the subsidy cutoff of about $62,600. Priced for an early retiree aged 45-55; older retirees should budget more.

transportation.description: A paid-off used car with CA full-coverage insurance and gas — essentially mandatory in a valley built for driving

entertainment.description: The free outdoors — Alum Rock Park, the foothill trails, and sunny Mediterranean weather

1M.lifestyle: A disciplined but genuinely livable Silicon Valley life. Housing is a modest studio in a working East San Jose or Berryessa neighborhood, where the Bay Area rent floor keeps it the largest line by far. A paid-off used car is non-negotiable in a valley built for driving with only thin light-rail coverage, so rent, the car, and a subsidized marketplace health plan anchor the budget. Meals lean on home cooking and San Jose's superb, affordable Vietnamese, Mexican, and pan-Asian food, with an occasional taqueria or pho run as a treat. Recreation is the free outdoors — Alum Rock Park, the foothill trails, and reliably sunny Mediterranean weather. Little margin, but the essentials and the climate are covered.

healthcare.description: An individual plan nearer the cliff, at a richer metal tier

3M.lifestyle: A comfortable South Bay life anchored by a quality one-bedroom in a desirable, walkable district like Willow Glen, Campbell, or the Santana Row area. Dining out regularly across the valley's deep Vietnamese, Japanese, and Mexican restaurant scene is routine, and a newer car opens weekend drives to Santa Cruz, Big Sur, Napa, or Tahoe. A solid private health plan, Sharks games, and hiking in the Santa Cruz Mountains all fit without budget math. California's income tax is a persistent headwind, but day-to-day life at this level is easy, sunny, and well-connected.

10M.lifestyle: The top of Silicon Valley living, anchored by a luxury penthouse or top-tier home in the Santana Row area, a downtown high-rise, or the Los Gatos foothills. A private chef several nights a week, a luxury vehicle with occasional car service, full household help, and Stanford concierge medicine are simply routine, alongside first-class travel and a standing place on the region's cultural and tech-event circuit. The Bay Area's ultra-prime market means the home is a premium residence rather than a sprawling estate, but the food, weather, and access are hard to match — even after California's top tax bite.
